clips.title: The story
paras: The Water Sapta is a ceremonial draught used to attune one's spiritual sight to the hidden spirits and corruptions of water. Entrusted with this preparation, the bearer is sent to locate tainted pond water within the fields of Westfall to investigate an elemental imbalance.

In the elemental traditions of shamans, a sapta is a ceremonial concoction prepared to pierce the veil between the physical realm and the spirits. The Water Sapta attunes the senses specifically to the element of water, granting the spiritual vision necessary to perceive elemental disturbances and hidden spirits. Without such an attunement, ordinary travelers could look directly upon an elemental manifestation and see nothing more than ordinary ripples.

The directive behind the Water Sapta sends the bearer to Westfall, an arid Alliance realm troubled by unrest and neglect. Within this windswept land lies a tainted pond whose waters suffer from spiritual pollution. Guided by the sapta's perception, the bearer must seek out these corrupted waters to uncover the disturbance and restore harmony to the local water spirits.

clips.title: Completion
paras: Take the water sapta and find the tainted pond water in Westfall, friend. I have great faith in your abilities.
